info.description:
Image-to-image API for home interior/exterior redesign + portrait stylize + tidy/reorganize room (Kontext).

- POST /deepart/image_generate  — main generation endpoint (auto-routes by prompt substring)
- GET  /                         — health check

Auth: Authorization: Api-Key {{api_key}}

image_generate auto-routes:
- prompt contains 'home interior' or 'home exterior' (no mask)  -> control mode (MLSD+Depth + Depth LoRA)
- prompt contains 'smartspace boost'                                    -> Kontext mode (Gemini analyzes scene -> swap 2 furniture pieces)
- otherwise                                                      -> inpaint mode (cartoon LoRA + face mask)

SUPPORTED STYLES (NestAI parity, gui trong prompt dang "... luxurious {Style}. home interior"):
Modern, Minimalistic, Scandinavian, Japandi, Japanese, Zen, Luxury, Industrial, Rustic, Farmhouse, Farm House, Cozy, Midcentury, Mid century, Biophilic, Coastal, Mediterranean, Tropical, Bohemian, Vintage, Cottage, Cottagecore, Art Deco, Baroque, Brutalist, Chinese, French, French Country, Gothic, Italianate, Middle Eastern, Morocco, Spanish, Ski Chalet, Soho Style, Technoland, Cyberpunk, Gamer, Wood, Chocolate, Airbnb, Christmas, Rainbow, Discotheque, Creepy, Medieval, Ancient Egyptian, Man Cave, Loft, Old Money, Cartoon

request.description:
Tidy / re-organize a room photo via Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite + FLUX Kontext. Shares the /deepart/image_generate endpoint with other modes — substring 'smartspace boost' in the prompt triggers the Kontext route.

Flow:
1. Gemini analyzes the photo, picks 2 main furniture pieces (sofa+armchair, bed+wardrobe, fridge+island, ...), their current sides (left/right), accessories, clutter to remove, and an alternative piece from the image (fallback for twin-object cases).
2. Code composes CLIP + T5 prompts: object_1 and object_2 swap sides; object_2 also gets a +90° rotation hint to coax wall-anchored furniture. If the two objects look near-identical (matching color/material), it falls back to a 'keep object_1, replace object_2 with alt_object_from_image' branch.
3. FLUX Kontext regenerates the image at a preferred resolution bucket (672x1568 ... 1568x672).

Response: PNG/JPEG of the reorganized room.

Latency: ~20-30s for one image at NUM_INFERENCE_STEPS=25.
